spanish: Y se despojará sus vestidos, y vestirá vestidos otros, y sacará la ceniza a fuera al campamento, a lugar puro.

findings.issue: Unmarked reflexive se is not licensed. The verb is qal 3ms with את marking the garments as direct object, and the 3ms suffix only marks whose garments; there is no reflexive stem.

notes: The rest of the clause chain matches the qal and hiphil 3ms verbs, both plural garment phrases, the definite singular ash, and the two אל phrases.
